question: When a completed US500 daily close breaks beyond the full high or low of the preceding twenty completed daily market bars, does the next five-daily-bar path support a frequent and cost-positive continuation or reversion response?
closure_reason: P1 passed the complete source, real-tick, raw-tick-manifest, visible-specification and observer-fault integrity boundary and produced 22 resolved observations. Calendar halves were dense at 10/12 and upper breaks were 18, but lower breaks were only 4 versus the predeclared minimum of 5. The density contract therefore stopped the unit before continuation or reversion economics were read and before P2 could open.
economic_interpretation: This is a structural breadth failure, not economic evidence for or against monthly-range continuation or reversion. The state occurred broadly across the year but was one-sided in breakout sign under the single frozen lookback and horizon.
